parked.finding: no finding: lien_position blank on 17 loans (126.5M) at 2025-09-30
hypotheses: The page-read bridge reads 'Second Lien' for these rows but with status validation_needed: the tier rollup fails (rows found 200,474 against the printed 'Total Second Lien Debt $ 224,439 $ 218,003') because Crash Champions' two loans (contexts c-326 first lien 4,495 and c-382 second lien 17,529) share one member, so the bridge cannot key the 17,529 row.
lien_position is not a row-correctable field and the member carries no lien text (lien_from_identifier cannot express it).
A fix needs shared code (bridge keyed by member and fair value, or lien_position made correctable); not attempted.

observations.what: 16 dollar pars (2023-12-31 to 2026-03-31, fair value 61.2M in all, 13.6M the largest) were published in CAD and converted at the CAD rate. Cause found: not a carry-over inside the pipeline. The filer tagged these principal facts with unitRef="cad" (e.g. 0001901164-24-000009 c-188 and c-189, TC Signature, the two lines right after New Look Vision Group's CAD line), so its own tagging carried the unit of the foreign line above. The shared step that lets it through: the principal currency is taken from the principal fact's unit in staging (pipeline/monetary_units.resolve_bdc_units -> _financial_units.principal_amount) and converted by pipeline/monetary_fx.principal_reference_table, with no check against the printed currency cell that the page-read bridge already holds (bdc_ixbrl_field_status.printed_row). Fixed here by row correction.
observations.suggested_check: For each row with a non-USD principal unit, the printed row (bdc_ixbrl_field_status.printed_row) must carry that currency code before the par; a dollar line tagged in a foreign unit is a finding.

observations.what: Rows printed under 'Preferred Equity', 'Common Stocks', 'Equity Investments' and 'Asset Backed Securities' were published as direct-lending loans (1 to 12 rows a quarter, up to 66.4M at 2026-03-31) because the member names no class; their unit counts were published as par. Fixed by row correction for this fund.
observations.suggested_check: Per fund-quarter, published fair value by class against the printed section totals (the page-read bridge already walks the section headings).

observations.what: 2025-09-30: 17 loans (126.5M) publish no lien; the bridge withholds the whole Second Lien tier because Crash Champions' two loans share one member and the 17,529 second-lien row cannot be keyed, so the tier does not roll up to its printed total. Other quarters carry lien on every loan.
observations.suggested_check: Count loans with blank lien per fund-quarter against neighbouring quarters; a jump from 0 to many is a withheld tier.

observations.what: 2025-09-30: both Crash Champions loans (4,495 first lien 2/23/2029, 17,529 second lien 2/15/2029) publish no maturity; same cause as the lien gap (one member, two contexts). A row correction cannot address one of two rows with the same identifier. The first-lien row's SOFR is right but labelled inferred_post_libor.
observations.suggested_check: Loan rows with a printed maturity and a blank published maturity, keyed on fair value where the member repeats.

observations.what: Vertical Bridge second lien prints maturity 5/15/2024 at 2024-12-31 and 2025-03-31 (5/15/2054 in the neighbouring quarters); the build withholds the past date and publishes none. Left: correcting it would publish a value the page does not print.

The filer moves holdings between sections: at 2025-03-31 CSAT, the second Iconic Purchaser line and Cheval Blanc are printed under 'Preferred Equity' (no Common Stocks section that quarter), common from 2025-06-30; National Resilience's 8.00 % note (7/23/2035) is under 'Preferred Equity' at 2025-09-30 only and in first lien before and after. Published as printed, so these positions change class between quarters.
observations.suggested_check: Positions whose class changes between quarters with no change in rate, maturity or units.
